findings.detail: The raw source contains a prior-period debt and equity investment schedule totaling 847,197,092 that must not be summed into the June 30, 2025 companyfacts Level 3 fair value anchor of 691,956,192.
The current fair value disclosure separates Level 1 cash equivalents and short-term investments from the Level 3 debt and equity total, so those rows are outside the companyfacts_fv anchor scope.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation decides the flag. The filing's current schedule reports Total Debt & Equity Investments fair value of 691,956,192, and the fair value hierarchy table reports Level 3 total assets of 691,956 thousand, matching the companyfacts_fv anchor. The extracted holdings sum is 2,128,161,158, which is more than three times the current Level 3 debt/equity anchor and also exceeds the current Total Investments line of 1,093,518,278. Source structure shows prior-period investment schedule totals and non-Level-3 cash/short-term buckets near the leaked amounts, so the aggregate conservation failure is a real extraction/scope error rather than a bad anchor. The exact residual is not fully localized to one row, so localized is false.
